cell_line.evidence: For mass spectrometry analysis, 5 independent whole cell extracts were prepared from MDA-MB-231 cells untreated or treated for 18 h with CX-5461 at 700 nM, BMH-21 at 1000 nM, or Actinomycin D at 0.05 µg/mL, using a lysis buffer containing 62.5 mM Tris–HCl, 1% SDS and 1 mM DTT.

cell_type.evidence: inferred: MDA-MB-231 and BT-20 cells were cultured in DMEM-F12 medium (Life Technologies) supplemented with 1% GlutaMAX (Life Technologies), 10% foetal bovine serum (CliniSciences), and 1% penicillin–streptomycin (10,000 U/mL; Life Technologies).
